messages:
Ravi: Quick sync on model catalog compare UX — a few items from today's QA: pinning flow, pin visibility, and the perf badge tooltip copy.
Noa: Saw the notes. First: when you pin a version, there's no undo quickly visible. Users expected a short 'undo' inline.
Priya: We could add a 5s toast with an Undo button. Also thinking about pin TTL — sometimes pins are only relevant for a sprint. Maybe optional expiration?
Oscar: Interesting. If we add TTL, we need a small UI in the pin modal: 'Keep pinned until' with options: session / 7 days / forever. Defaults to session to avoid clutter.
Ella: Session default is safer. But show where expiring pins live — maybe a filter 'Pinned (expiring)' so PMs can revisit.
Ravi: Visuals — how to indicate expiring pin on the row? Small clock icon on the chip with tooltip like 'Pinned, expires in 3 days'.
Noa: Tooltip text should be concise: 'Pinned until Mar 28 (3d)'. Keep it localised-friendly.
Priya: Pin undo: inline snackbar with 'Undo' works for quick mistakes. For global pins, require confirmation modal with 'Make global' checkbox.
Oscar: On pin propagation: important to clarify difference between compare-session pin vs global pin in copy. Propose chip variants: 'Pinned (local)' or 'Pinned (global)'. Maybe use different tone: filled vs outlined chip.
Ella: Accessibility: the chip needs role=button and aria-pressed states. Screen reader should announce pinned state and expiration.
Ravi: Performance badge copy — current tooltip is 'Perf: Good'. Engineers want specific guidance: show baseline SLA and model's measured metric, plus link to history.
Noa: Proposed tooltip: 'Latency P95: 210ms (SLA: 200ms). History ->' with link target. If over SLA, show 'At risk' in bold.
Priya: Color semantics: green/orange/red are fine, but add an icon for color-blind users (check, exclamation, cross). Tests needed.
Oscar: Also consider click-to-pin from the perf hover card so users can pin a model while inspecting metrics. Reduces context switch.
Ella: Keyboard: badge hover card must open via Enter/Space when focused. Card focus trap should allow tabbing to the 'Pin' CTA and 'Details' link.
Ravi: Layout: at narrow widths action menu is hidden under kebab; ensure the pin action is not buried. Maybe duplicate a small pin icon visible in the compact view.
Noa: Copy nit on compare title: change 'Compare models' to 'Compare versions' when multiple versions present to reduce confusion.
Priya: Also add microcopy under the compare header: 'Pinned items persist for this session unless made global.'
Oscar: Edge case: syncing pins between devices — if someone pins in desktop then opens mobile, how do we surface? For now, local=client-only, global=server synced. Document that in UX notes.
Ella: I'll draft ARIA strings and keyboard order. Priya will write toast copy variants. Noa will update figma with TTL flow and chip states. Ravi will consolidate and add QA checklist.
UXBot: Checklist reminder: include localization keys for all new strings, aria-labels, high-contrast color swatches, and unit tests for keyboard flows.
Ravi: Thanks team. Let's reconvene after Figma updates — aiming EOD tomorrow.
